bio-gen-01-c1.text: National Human Genome Research Institute. Deoxyribonucleic Acid (DNA). Talking Glossary of Genomic and Genetic Terms, genome.gov.
bio-gen-01-c1.quote: adenine bonds with thymine, and cytosine bonds with guanine.
bio-gen-01-c1.claim: A always pairs with T, and G always pairs with C.

bio-gen-01-c1.text: King's College London. The story behind Photograph 51. King's College London.
bio-gen-01-c1.quote: Photograph 51, and other data from Rosalind’s work during her time at King’s, were key to building the structure of DNA
bio-gen-01-c1.claim: Watson and Crick worked this out in 1953 using Rosalind Franklin's X-ray data.

bio-gen-01-c2.text: National Human Genome Research Institute. Exome. Talking Glossary of Genomic and Genetic Terms, genome.gov.
bio-gen-01-c2.quote: In humans, the exome is about 1.5% of the genome.
bio-gen-01-c2.claim: Only about 1.5% of human DNA codes for proteins.
